content.text:
./composer.json is valid
=== vendor autoload ===
-rw-rw-rw- 1 ddevuser ddevuser 748 Oct  5 20:16 vendor/autoload.php
-rw-rw-rw- 1 ddevuser ddevuser 268 Oct  5 20:16 web/autoload.php
=== ddev config ===
type: drupal11
docroot: web
php_version: "8.4"
webserver_type: nginx-fpm
database:
    type: mysql
# type: <projecttype>  # asterios, backdrop, cakephp, codeigniter, craftcms, drupal, drupal6, drupal7, drupal8, drupal9, drupal10, drupal11, drupal12, generic, joomla, laravel, magento, magento2, php, shopware6, silverstripe, symfony, typo3, wordpress, wp-bedrock
# information on the different project types
# docroot: <relative_path> # Relative path to the directory containing index.php.
# php_version: "8.4"  # PHP version to use, "5.6" through "8.5"

observation.command: cd /workspace && su ddevuser -c "ddev composer validate --no-check-all --no-check-publish" 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== vendor autoload ==="; ls -la vendor/autoload.php web/autoload.php 2>&1; echo "=== ddev config ==="; grep -E "php_version|database|type|docroot" .ddev/config.yaml 2>/dev/null | head
